title: fix(objectql): an artifact hot reload refreshes every registry entry the boot registered, so an edited email template is what the next send renders
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu96YrKSitCWAfPtJGCAS6LD)_

Fixes #27488

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os dev` 热重载 artifact 后，引擎把它已装的包重新登记一遍，邮件模板、流程、仪表盘、页面、按钮等所有类型的列表读与发送读都跟上新版本。
- **为什么改**：开发者改了邮件模板源码，按名字读已经是新文案，但列表和实际发出的邮件还是旧文案，要冷重启才生效；流程热重载也绑的是旧定义。
- **风险与回滚**：只走开发热重载路径，冷启动和 `PUT /meta` 保存不受影响（有测试钉住）；只刷新已装的包，禁用状态保留；回滚即还原 `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` 一处。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（`refreshReloadedPackages` 与它在 `metadata:reloaded` 钩子里的调用）、`packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts`、`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-artifact-reload.integration.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts`，预期 3 条全绿；去掉钩子里那一行调用则第一条转红，列表读停在 v1。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The boot registers an artifact twice: the artifact door (`MetadataPlugin`) into the metadata service, and `AppPlugin` into the SchemaRegistry through the `manifest` service. A hot reload (artifact-file watcher or HMR POST, both `_reloadAndAnnounce`) re-registered only the first, and ObjectQL's `metadata:reloaded` hook re-ingested objects alone. The by-name read asks the metadata service first, so it served the edit; the list read and its execution face (`getMetaItemsForExecution`) lay the registry over the metadata service, so they kept the boot copy until a cold restart. The email plugin renders a send from that execution face, and the automation engine re-binds flows from it on the same reload.

The hook now calls `refreshReloadedPackages` before the object ingest: each package body on the payload that the registry already holds (source `code` or `marketplace`) is re-registered through `registerApp`, the body door the boot used, under its installed source, with `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` for the order (the call the `manifest` service makes). `installPackage` keeps the lifecycle on a re-install, so a disabled package stays disabled. A package the boot never put in the registry is left to the artifact door as before (nothing of it is stale there). A body that fails to re-register is named in one `warn` line and keeps its previous entries; the reload goes on.

Scope (the card's first deliverable): measured on the real `createStandaloneStack` composition, every registry-backed type was stale, not only `email_template`. With each type at v1 at boot and v2 in the file, before the fix:

| type | list | execution face | by name |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email_template`, `dashboard`, `flow`, `page`, `action` | v1 | v1 | v2 |
| `object` | v2 | v2 | v2 |

So the fix refreshes every collection `registerApp` decomposes. That changes no semantics for the other types: it makes their list and execution reads agree with the by-name read, the same defect. The flow re-bind on reload (service-automation's `metadata:reloaded` re-sync) now binds the edited flow, which is what that re-sync was written for.

File surface: `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` only, plus a test in `packages/runtime` and one in `packages/plugins/plugin-email`. No `packages/spec`, no `objectql/src/engine.ts`. Branch is the card thread's harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-mtq6wj` (the claim is the identity record).

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts` (new): the real `os dev` composition and the real reload body. Pins list, execution face and by-name for six types after one and two reloads (v1 positive control at boot = cold boot), the package record (source, enabled, status) across a reload, and that an environment save through `saveMetaItem` still wins on all three reads after a reload re-registers the package beneath it.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-artifact-reload.integration.test.ts` (new): real `ObjectQLPlugin`, the app registered through the `manifest` service at init as `AppPlugin` does, the artifact door's reload payload, and a real `EmailService` send over the loader `EmailServicePlugin` wires. The send renders the reloaded subject and the list serves it.

Red before the fix: plugin-email `expected 'Task done (v1): Ship it' to be 'Task done (v2): Ship it'`; runtime: the five types above listed v1 on both list faces.

## Acceptance notes

- Items removed from the artifact stay registered until restart, the lifecycle objects already have on this path. Not measured as a defect here; noted only.
- A reload that adds a brand-new package to the artifact does not install it into the registry (refresh only); the artifact door serves it, as before.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation (fix commit 41d95a77): drop the refresh call, both pins go red; restore, both green</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` replaced `this.refreshReloadedPackages(ctx, payload);` in `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` with a marker statement (on-disk counts: marker 1, call 0), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build`, and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs objectql '__ABLATE_27488'` found the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs` (the JS reached dist; the DTS step reported the now-unused method, which does not change the JS the suites load).

- plugin-email pin: red, `expected 'Task done (v1): Ship it' to be 'Task done (v2): Ship it'`.
- runtime pin: red, `1 failed | 1 passed (2)` (the reload case; list and execution face back on v1).

Restore: `--restore` gave blob after restore == blob at HEAD (`4aa979799172`), `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt, `--absent` preflight: marker absent from all 14 built files, tree clean. Both pins green again (`1 passed (1)`, `2 passed (2)`). The preservation pin for an environment save was added after the ablation; it is a keep-alone pin, green with the fix.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites (after merging origin/main at 37e2caf7, closure rebuilt)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 486 passed (486), Tests 9128 passed (9128).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`: Test Files 45 passed (45), Tests 747 passed (747).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts`: 3 passed (3). The rest of the runtime suite is left to CI (`Test Core`): the diff adds one test file there and changes no runtime source.
- typecheck: `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-email` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`), `@objectstack/runtime`: all exit 0.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the three changed files: exit 0.
</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this tree, every command run with its exit code captured before any pipe, then `--ran`: "63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
